name: Cogwork Redeemer
text:
Draft this card face up.
As you draft the last card of a booster pack, you may reveal it and note its name.
Flying, vigilance
You may cast spells with names noted by this creature without paying their mana cost.

name: Duel Masters
text:
(Start the game with this conspiracy face up in the command zone.)
You don't have a life total.
At the start of the game, put the top five cards of your library face-down in front of you as shields.
If you would lose life, instead put one of your shields into your hand. If you can't, you lose the game.

name: Emrakul, Disturbing Reality
text:
Partner with Kozilek, Unfathomable Truth and Ulamog, Eternal Consumer
Whenever you cast this spell, target opponent shuffles thirty confusion cards into their library.
At the beginning of your end step, if you both own and control this creature and a creature named Kozilek, Unfathomable Truth and a creature named Ulamog, Eternal Consumer, exile them, then meld them into The Three.

name: Everything is a Conspiracy
text:
(Start the game with this conspiracy face up in the command zone.)
You can't cast more than one spell each turn.
Noncreature spells you cast have conspire. (As you cast the spell, you may tap two untapped creatures you control that share a color with it. When you do, copy it and you may choose new targets for the copy. A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)

name: Fresh Start
text:
(Start the game with this conspiracy face up in the command zone.)
Whenever you take a mulligan, you may exile your hand instead of shuffling your hand into your library.
flavorText: Another chance to do it right.

name: Gooser-Cruiser
text:
Whenever this Vehicle attacks, create a Golden Egg token. If this creature is saddled, instead create two of those tokens.
Crew 1
Saddle 1 (Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 3 or more: This Mount becomes saddled until end of turn. Saddle only as a sorcery.)

name: Height Advantage
text:
(Start the game with this conspiracy face up in the command zone.)
Lethal damage dealt to creatures you control is determined by their power rather than their toughness.
flavorText: It's better to stand aside than to stand out.

name: Karametra's Beloved
flavorText: Forged by Purphoros and shaped by Nylea, this gift from her two former lovers stands as a reminder that even hands hardened and stained by violence, though they may alter nature's perfection, can still craft beauty beyond imagination.

name: Kozilek, Unfathomable Truth
text:
Partner with Emrakul, Disturbing Reality and Ulamog, Eternal Consumer
Trample
When you cast this spell, exile five random cards from the cube pool face-down. An opponent separates those cards into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. You may cast spells from it without paying their mana cost.

name: Magus of the Petal
text: {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Add one mana of any color.
flavorText: To be entrusted with the petal is to be free of greed and untouched by human affairs—and even then, one must endure a rite that strips away the last traces of their humanity.

name: Mox Amethyst
text: Nyxborn — {T}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if you control three or more enchantments.
flavorText:
"Gathering the stars, fourteen gods entrusted Phorphoros to forge them into one perfect jewel, which they hurled to the earth — and from its impact, humanity emerged."
—Theros' Tale of Creation

name: Pizza Oven
text:
{T}: Create a Food token named Cheese, Dough or Tomato.
{2}{R}, {T}, Sacrifice a Cheese, a Dough and a Tomato: Create a Pizza token. (It's an artifact Food token with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 9 life and draw three cards.)

name: Soul Ring
text: {T}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Add {C}{C}.
flavorText: It holds every final goodbye, every hidden tear, each missed moment, every forsaken dream, and lingering regret — yet within it, a light endures, not to mourn what's lost, but to transform it into something greater.

name: Surveillance State
text:
(Start the game with this conspiracy face up in the command zone.)
Lands you control enter tapped.
Whenever a land enters under your control, surveil 1.
flavorText: The convenience of the many must be ensured through the inconvenience of the few.

name: The Real Power Behind the Throne
text:
Hidden agenda (Start the game with this conspiracy face down in the command zone and secretly choose a card name. You may turn this conspiracy face up any time and reveal that name.)
When you turn this Conspiracy face-up, search your library for a legendary creature card with the chosen name, reveal it, put it into your command zone, then shuffle. It becomes your commander. For the rest of the game, you can only cast spells that share a color with your commander.

name: Ulamog, Eternal Consumer
text:
Partner with Emrakul, Disturbing Reality and Kozilek, Unfathomable Truth
When you cast this spell, exile two target permanents.
When Ulamog enters, combine all permanent cards from target opponent's exile onto it.
Combinnihilator 4 (Whenever Ulamog attacks, defending player choose four permanents they control to be combined with Ulamog.)
